notes.title: Regular Update Notes For 03 Jun
notes.content:
Update v1.0.5

Enhanced Zoom In/Out:
Smooth Zoom feature added, enabling smoother and extended zoom-out capability.

Expanded Screen Resolution:
New screen resolution option: 2560x1440 with a 21:9 aspect ratio.

Enhanced Mission-Saving Task

Enhanced Distance Graphic Quality:
Improved rendering of distant graphics for enhanced realism and visual quality.
